name: scanqr
description: QR codes, fully local: generate a QR for any text with a proper quiet zone (cv2 encoder, self-read verified via zxing-cpp) and scan/decode QRs or barcodes from an image file. This build's cv2 QR decoder is broken, so decoding uses the standalone zxing-cpp reader.
route: qr code for https://x.pk, generate a qr for wifi: sid/pass, scan the qr in D:/ticket.png, read the qr D:/code.png, decode qr D:/x.png
